name: Tal
summary: At Thunder Bluff, Tal tends the Horde's chief wind rider roost above the plains of Mulgore. He sends seasoned wyverns carrying travelers across Kalimdor.

sections.title: Keeper of the High Roost
sections.body: Tal tends the wind rider roost on Thunder Bluff's central mesa, linking the tauren capital with the rest of the Horde. He cares for the loyal wind riders, or wyverns, keeping them healthy and well-fed for long journeys across Kalimdor. From the roost, he sends messengers to Camp Taurajo and scouts across the Barrens to Orgrimmar. The flights keep the towering mesa city in touch with its allies.

faq.q: What role does Tal play in Thunder Bluff?
faq.answer: Tal is Thunder Bluff's wind rider master. He oversees the roost atop the bluffs, cares for the winged beasts, and arranges flights across Kalimdor for members of the Horde.
Tal sends travelers from Thunder Bluff to places across central and southern Kalimdor, including Camp Taurajo, the Crossroads, Orgrimmar, and distant wilderness outposts.

faq.q: Why are wind riders used instead of traditional mounts?
faq.answer: Wind riders are flying mounts that provide swift, direct travel into and out of Thunder Bluff. The city's sheer cliffs and great height make ground routes slow and winding, while the flyers avoid the need to use the elevators.

angles.text: As a tauren venturing beyond your ancestral pastures, you can rely on Tal for the quickest and safest passage from the high bluffs into the broader world.
As a member of the Horde, you can use Tal's roost to travel between the tauren capital, the Crossroads, and Orgrimmar.
